interpretation.bestof_only: Exactly zero changed probabilities. Agent 1 does not consume best_of_sets; the BO3 defect does not change A1 ratings or A1 evaluation results.
interpretation.surface_and_bestof: Identical to surface_only, confirming the two corrections are independent and only the surface metadata moves A1.
interpretation.surface_only: A real but separate effect from the NULL AO 2026 surface. Measured as a bounded counterfactual on the stored A1 target population; not a production model change.

a1_surface_sensitivity.scope: A1 targets since 2026-09-10, settled COMPLETED only

dependencies.a1_best_of_dependency: NONE. Agent 1 validates best_of_sets > 0 but never uses the value in rating updates or probability prediction; the regression `test_best_of_sets_does_not_change_v1_probability` asserts equality.
dependencies.a1_surface_dependency: REAL AND SEPARATE. 229 completed AO 2026 matches enter A1 history with NULL surface, so they update overall Elo only. This is a surface-metadata effect, not a best-of effect.
dependencies.a2_dependency: NONE FOR 2026. API-Tennis AO 2026 has zero match_stat_observations, so no AO 2026 row can be used in A2 serve/return fitting. The 40 2016-2025 QF rows have best_of=5 and round QF; A2 resolves the main-draw BO5 rule and the flag disagreement does not block the update. The 115 qualifying rows are BO3 and have no 2026 stats.
dependencies.manager_dependency: ZERO. No AO prediction target, consensus row or decision exists.
dependencies.research_experiment_dependency: The A1 identity-bridge and label-shuffle experiments use A1 history, not AO as an evaluation target. Their BO3 dependency is zero; their surface dependency is bounded by the A1 surface sensitivity evidence.

edition_reconciliation.bracket_conclusion: Edition 2248 holds the genuine draw but is missing the Djokovic-Mensik R16 match (both R32 winners are absent from R16). Edition 2249 contributes two cancelled phantom R128 rows, producing 66 R128 rows and 128 main-draw rows in total. Excluding the phantom rows, 126 genuine main-draw rows remain: one fewer than the official 127.
edition_reconciliation.qualifying_conclusion: Edition 2248 holds 112 genuine qualifying rows (64 QF, 32 SF, 16 F). Edition 2249 adds three cancelled phantom QF rows, giving 115. The official qualifying draw is 112.
